joy_con.title: Change Joy-Con color
joy_con.description:
You can change the internal color of your Joy-Con. Make sure they are attached.
The color profile will be saved in `{}`. Go to '{}' to generate your own custom profile.
joy_con.label: Change Joy-Con color
joy_con.backing_up: Backing up the current color profile. Make sure the Joy-Cons are attached. If the process hangs, try detaching and reattaching the Joy-Cons.
joy_con.changing: Changing color. Make sure the Joy-Cons are attached. If the process hangs, try detaching and reattaching the Joy-Cons.
joy_con.all_done: Done! You may need to detach and reattach your Joy-Cons for the change to take effect.

pro_con.title: Change Pro Controller color
pro_con.desc: You can change the internal color of your Pro Controller. Make sure it is assigned to player 1.
pro_con.warning: AIO-Switch-Updater currently does not support changing the Pro Controller grip color. Use Joy-Con Toolkit on PC instead.
pro_con.label: Change Pro Controller color
pro_con.all_done: Done! You may need to power-cycle the Pro Controller for the change to take effect.
pro_con.changing: Changing color. Make sure the Pro Controller is assigned to player 1.

main.firmware_text:
◆ Firmwares directly from THZoria's GitHub. Once downloaded, it will be extracted to '/firmware'. You can then install the update using Daybreak.
◆ Current FW:
main.cheats_text:
◆ This will download a daily updated cheats package from 'GBATemp.net'. Cheats for games you don't have installed will not be extracted to your SD card. You can disable updated cheats from 'Tools→Cheats menu'.
◆ Current cheats version:
main.ams_text: ◆ From this menu you can download and update the Atmosphère custom firmware needed to run homebrew.
main.links_not_found:
The following package contains the entire CFW for Nintendo Switch as well as the latest FW version ready to install with Daybreak.
If you only want to download the firmware, go to the 'Download Firmwares' tab.
main.launch_warning:
Please pay attention to the following points before using the app:

◆ Read first about how to manually update your Switch. This will help you better understand what this app does and what to do in case something goes wrong.
◆ To avoid any risk of data corruption, using this app on an exFAT SD card is strongly discouraged.

◆ I recommend opening this app without Applet Mode

This screen will not be shown again.
main.theme_warning:
It looks like you have a custom theme installed. This may cause the system to fail to boot after updating the firmware.
Please consider removing the theme before updating.

Do you want to continue?
main.hekate_ipl_label: ◆ Download a basic "working" hekate_ipl.ini. This will overwrite your current hekate_ipl.ini.
